moves.label: Trade: Marvin Bagley III, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and others
moves.description: Marvin Bagley III was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick and a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own). Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for Serge Ibaka, the draft rights to David Michineau and cash. Serge Ibaka, a Least Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Donte DiVincenzo, Rodney Hood, Semi Ojeleye and the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman. Donte DiVincenzo, Josh Jackson, Trey Lyles, the draft rights to Ilkan Karaman, the draft rights to David Michineau, a 2024 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for Marvin Bagley III, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a 2024 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: James Wiseman, Saddiq Bey, Kevin Knox II, Saddiq Bey, Gary Payton II and others
moves.description: James Wiseman was acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Saddiq Bey and Kevin Knox II. Saddiq Bey was acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE. Gary Payton II, a 2026 2nd round pick (ATL own), a 2028 2nd round pick (ATL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for James Wiseman, a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own). Kevin Knox II, a conditional 2025 2nd round pick (ATL own), a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a conditional 2024 2nd round pick (ATL own), a conditional 2026 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2028 2nd round pick (GOS own) and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Gary Payton II and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Dennis Schroder, Lindy Waters III, K.J. Martin, P.J. Tucker, Davion Mitchell and others
moves.description: Dennis Schroder and Lindy Waters III were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for K.J. Martin, a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. P.J. Tucker, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash were acquired by the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Davion Mitchell. Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Andrew Wiggins, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Miami Heat in exchange for Jimmy Butler III, Josh Richardson, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash. Jimmy Butler III, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Kyle Anderson, Dennis Schroder, Lindy Waters III, Andrew Wiggins and a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own). K.J. Martin, Josh Richardson, a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Utah Jazz in exchange for P.J. Tucker and a Swap 2031 2nd round picks.

assumptions: For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reconstructed career-path pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-05-31; legal rights are dated 2026-05-31.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.

moves.label: Trade: John Collins, Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser, Tarik Biberovic, A.J. Johnson and others
moves.description: A conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for John Collins and cash. Santi Aldama, Marcus Sasser and the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for A.J. Johnson, Khris Middleton, a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own) and a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own). Khris Middleton, a 2033 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a TPE were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for D'Angelo Russell, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks, a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE. Caris LeVert, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and cash were acquired by the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. A.J. Johnson, D'Angelo Russell, Isaiah Stewart II, a 2029 2nd round pick (LAL own), a 2029 2nd round pick (HOU own), a conditional 2030 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2032 2nd round picks and a 2033 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Santi Aldama, the draft rights to Tarik Biberovic, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own). John Collins, Gary Harris, Taurean Prince, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DET own), a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DET own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for Caris LeVert, Marcus Sasser, Isaiah Stewart II, a Least Favorable 2027 2nd round pick, a 2027 2nd round pick (MIL own) and a conditional 2030 2nd round pick (DET own).

player_coverage.injury_review_note: Source-reviewed dated major-absence corpus and current captured app injury overlays; targeted method review, not an exhaustive historical clinical archive.

assumptions: First-round forfeitures are excluded before the lottery. Under the new system, keep the remaining relegated teams’ No.12floor and origin-based repeat-pick restrictions. Second-round ordering uses the full30-origin counterfactual lottery. This forfeiture interaction is a modeling assumption pending a detailed NBA procedure.
For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reported most-favorable DET-held2028right, top55protected; physicalDET56–60is already owedPHI and is never reassigned.
Top-N second-round protections use actual overall numbers, including a second-round selection atNo.30 after a first-round forfeiture.
Reconstructed career-path pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-10-25; legal rights are dated 2026-10-31.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.
